ops.entry: WHEN ruling a must-fix against a class of unusable input DO name every axis the decision consumes — container shape, each read field's type and domain, and related records' identity — a remedy scoped to the observed instance leaves the adjacent axis for the next round, and rounds are budgeted.
ops.why: Three consecutive validate rounds each surfaced the next axis of one input class (container, then field, then identity) after remedies scoped to the instance seen; the last arrived with the rework budget spent and forced an escalation. Displaces P-12: pinning is the orchestrator's act, not this seat's.

originals.original: WHEN a post-validation fix needs delta review DO pin the review range from the last accepted pin through the exact post-fix commit — inheriting the earlier pin excludes the remediation, and grading a different range cannot clear it.
